### Fixes
- The stash list now shows an error when it cannot read a stash's untracked files, instead of showing that stash as empty.

### Improvements
- Syntax highlighting does less work per chunk, which helps on large files.
- Changing the theme or density re-renders only the parts that use the changed value.
- Internal code cleanup with no visible change.

See release assets for the platform installers and updater packages.
